reportedBugs: Shooting shield energy generators flashes the middle weapon.
rootCauses: October 2 core renderer ignored its supplied generator/helper socket and redrew the middle weapon for every caller.
Middle weapon used hull flash rather than its own part flash; generic module loop also drew an obsolete centre plate.
Generator overlay checked dead only, ignoring inactive field and rearm materialization.

native.scope: Protected native component fixtures; not an unassisted fight or balance proof.

limitations: Protected native fixtures verify component rendering, actual bullet damage routing, two seconds of post-break updates, and intended rearm. They are not complete encounter clears or balance evidence.
Intentional threshold rearm remains; a new generation can appear after its materialization. No art pixels, boss HP, damage, phase thresholds or rewards were changed.

doubleCheck.regressionReason: Runtime and regression files match the hashes from the passing full suite; only the native probe and documentation changed.
coverage: Actual native held beam removes a paired column, leaves opposite column and middle HP unchanged.
Broken generator Retina targets reject late damage.
Actual launched curved Retina missile damages a surviving generator.
All 75/50/25 percent HP threshold rearms on all four difficulties are triggered through actual hitBoss damage and native updates.
Weaponless ram branch removes generator visuals and locks together.
